description: From the Gefyra causeway, the sheer rock of Monemvasia rises out of the sea, and the walled lower town of stone houses and tile roofs sits at its foot. The upper town on the summit is a dark ruin. Cloud cover is about 21%, about 18.7°C. A few windows in the lower town are lit. The rock face is not floodlit.
